risk: Confabulated (made-up) policy answer leads staff to follow the wrong procedure
controls: Retrieval grounding with citations; 'not found' response; link to source policy; quarterly evaluation set

risk: Staff don't realise answers are AI-generated and over-trust them
controls: AI disclosure in the interface; short training on limits; feedback button

risk: Personal or patient data typed into prompts reaches the model vendor
controls: No-patient-data rule; PII detection before sending; data processing agreement; DPIA

risk: Prompt injection hidden in an indexed document changes the assistant's behaviour
controls: Curated corpus with document owners; documents passed as data; assistant has no tools or write access

risk: Out-of-date policy retrieved and presented as current
controls: Document owners and review dates; re-index on change; show document date in answers

risk: Vendor model update silently changes answer quality
controls: Pin model version; run evaluation set before any model change; vendor change notices

risk: Biased or inconsistent answers on HR policies for different groups of staff
controls: HR scenario tests in the evaluation set; human review of flagged answers

risk: Logs too thin to investigate a complaint or incident
controls: Log question; retrieved sources; answer; model version; 6-month retention

risk: Triage assistant under-estimates urgency and a patient is harmed
controls: No deployment without MDR conformity assessment; nurse makes the decision; conservative thresholds; clinical validation study

risk: Accuracy is lower for some patient groups (age; language; rare conditions)
controls: Representative training and test data; subgroup performance reporting; post-market monitoring

risk: Automation bias: nurses accept suggestions without independent assessment
controls: Show reasons and confidence; independent assessment step; audit override rates

risk: AI tools used without inventory or approval (shadow AI)
controls: AI system inventory; procurement gate; acceptable-use policy; AI literacy training
